serverInfo.name: 888box MCP Server
serverInfo.description: 888box unified asset management platform supporting image, video, audio, and file operations with WebMCP and MCP agent tools.

authentication.description: Provide a Bearer token via Authorization header, X-API-Key header, or token parameter. WebMCP in browser automatically uses same-origin session.

tools.name: upload_asset_by_url
tools.description: Upload an image, video, audio, or document file from a remote URL to 888box.

url.description: Direct URL of the asset to download and store

token.description: API Token (optional if logged in via session)

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List recently uploaded assets (images, videos, audios, files) with pagination.

tools.name: search_assets
tools.description: Search stored assets by keyword across title, path, and URL.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get site-wide statistics about asset counts (total, image, video, audio, file).

tools.name: get_podcast_info
tools.description: Get the current Podcast RSS feed URLs (video & audio) and subscription status.

tools.name: rebuild_podcast_rss
tools.description: Force a rebuild of the Podcast RSS feeds from the database (Admin only).

token.description: Admin API Token (optional if admin session)

tools.name: delete_asset
tools.description: Delete an asset and its storage file by ID (Admin only).

token.description: Admin API Token (optional if admin session)
